salarySource.quote: The average CTC stood at INR 18.83 lakhs, median CTC at INR 18.40 lakhs and highest CTC reached INR 33.12 lakhs (These figures are those who accepted the offer). [image-only PDF; transcribed visually from rendered page]

cutoffs.notes: Stage: JAP registration (minimum eligibility for PI-shortlisting pool). Minimums from the common JAP 2026 policy (hosted by IIM Raipur as coordinator), referenced by IIM Raipur's own MBA 2026-28 admission policy page. Academic minimums: X 60 / XII 60 / Grad 50 %. Positive scaled score required in all sections. Actual PI shortlist cut-offs (decided later and published on the JAP portal) were higher - IIM Ranchi/Trichy pages list GEN 95.25, EWS 89, NC-OBC 88.5, SC 75, ST 44, PwD 30 overall. IIM Raipur additionally requires graduation % for its merit list: GEN/EWS/NC-OBC 60, SC 50, ST 45, PwD 45.
